window.expected_evaluation_sessions: exact count from validated rolling KRX calendar; sealed in preflight.json

monthly_alignment.window_gap_policy: reject that candidate signal; no imputation

strategy_comparison.control: frozen PATTERN_A_FAST_FINAL_STRATEGY_V02 plus exact active COMMON PIT identity and shared 184-pair exclusions; no other entry filters
strategy_comparison.candidate: same frozen V2 evaluator; only prior-completed monthly alignment and exact signal-date KRX market_cap >= 500000000000 KRW entry gate

market_cap.authority: local immutable exact KRX raw market-date partition
market_cap.identity: exact signal-date PIT ticker + standard ISU_CD + market
market_cap.missing_duplicate_zero_invalid_or_unavai: reject candidate signal with exact cause; no date/ticker/market substitution

universe.authority: validated rolling merged PIT COMMON intervals
universe.eligibility: exact COMMON interval active on each signal date
universe.permanent_exclusion_matching: exact (ticker, standard ISU_CD) pairs, applied once before group split

portfolio.shares: integer floor after adverse buy slippage and commission
portfolio.cash_shortage: SKIPPED_CASH_UNAVAILABLE; fixed signals are not regenerated
portfolio.replay: single deterministic chronological event loop per group

valuation.daily_nav: available cash + unsettled sale proceeds + confirmed receivables + shares times valid exact-date adjusted close
valuation.normal_trading_day_missing_mark: whole-day NAV unresolved; no partial omission, zero fill, interpolation, nearest date, or arbitrary carry
valuation.carry: valuation only, only with exact RepositoryV2/KRX evidence of official non-trading placeholder
valuation.cutoff_positions: valid 2025-05-30 adjusted close, no hypothetical liquidation or costs

official_gates.A_integrity: zero material PIT/future/identity/lifecycle/cash/overlap/hidden-cap violations; unresolved material structural evidence is CHECK_REQUIRED
official_gates.B_costs: all filled sides include 0.015% commission and 0.1% adverse slippage; transaction tax excluded
official_gates.C_profitability: each group total_return > 0 and CAGR > 0; unresolved cutoff equity makes CHECK_REQUIRED
official_gates.D_mdd: both MDD >= -40%; candidate fails if CONTROL MDD - candidate MDD >= +5.0 percentage points
